title: Batch 11 Reflexology / Plantar Ground-Plane Concepts
patient_facing_caution: These are educational pattern-recognition concepts, not diagnostic claims.

concepts.summary: Reflexology zones carry neural-field representational information, not organ replacement. Plantar zones reflect vertical axis tension distribution. Small stimulus can have disproportionate effect if system is open/adaptive. Works better in chronic stuck states than acute destruction.

Foot is gravitationally anchored reference interface for entire vertical axis. KD-SP-BL state indicator. Treating plantar zones addresses upper pole overcompensation (headache, eye pressure, neck tension) by closing the axis loop below.

Meridians are embryologically fixed preferential tension-conduction directions within collagen-fascia continuum. Not discrete channels. Shaoyin (KD): anchors. Taiyin (SP): builds and holds. Shaoyang (GB/SJ): distributes and transitions.

Cell danger response Phase 3: integration failure — system cannot transition from repair (Yin) to function (Yang). Caused by mitochondrial weakness, water-grid contamination with inactive metabolites, or fragmented water-grid. Key mechanistic model for post-surgical chronic pain.
Structured water in fascia-collagen continuum maintains and transmits tension pattern. Decoherence produces oscillating signals and incomplete drainage. Restoration target in Phases 1-2.

key_principles: Small stimulus can have disproportionate effect if the system retains adaptivity.
Foot is the gravitationally anchored reference interface for the entire vertical axis.
Meridians are preferential tension-conduction directions within fascia.

non_default_concepts.summary: Auriculo-therapy: embryological gill-arch remnant; vagus/trigeminus/facialis/glossopharyngeus junction; autonomic gateway; rapid reset effect. Different logic from plantar. Not currently mapped to engine patterns.
Retina is CNS tissue; eye reflexology zones have direct CNS connection; strong, fast, but potentially unstable. Precision instrument, not general application. Not currently mapped to engine patterns.
